subject: LLamaIndex + LangChain API Schemas & Partner Playbook Discussion
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@sprocket.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sprocket AI Partnerships <partners@sprocket.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LLamaIndex + LangChain API Schemas & Partner Playbook Discussion

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well — I'm Daniel on the partnerships team at Sprocket AI. We're building a developer-facing knowledge product and are exploring a co-delivered partner toolkit that bundles a LlamaIndex-backed ingestion layer plus LangChain SDK primitives wired to Redwood's runtime for predictable latency and cost.

High-level asks:
- Confirm Redwood's recommended API schema for a "document + metadata" ingestion flow (we want to support embeddings + retrieval via LlamaIndex).
- Tracing: we need trace hooks surfaced to our telemetry (span ids, call-level latency) so we can show performance in our console.
- Prompt tooling: we'd like an opinionated prompt template set and a small evaluation harness to prevent regressions.

Would love a short technical sync to go over: API contract expectations, sample payloads, and any partner playbook requirements. I've attached our initial integration matrix (sprocket-integration-requirements.xlsx). Could you propose 30-45m slots next week?

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Partnerships, Sprocket AI
attachments: sprocket-integration-requirements.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@sprocket.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LLamaIndex + LangChain API Schemas & Partner Playbook Discussion

Hi Daniel — thanks for the note and the matrix. We're excited to explore this. Short answers up front and then a proposed next step:

- API schema: Redwood typically expects an ingestion envelope like {"documents": [{"id","text","metadata"}], "client_request_id"} for batch ingestion and a streaming append path for live capture. We'll share a small reference payload in the tech sync.
- Tracing: we can surface span IDs and token-level timing via our trace header (x-redwood-trace). Jonas will scope what we can emit to your telemetry endpoint and what needs an instrumentation shim on your side.
- Prompt tooling & evals: our developer partnerships playbook includes a starter prompt-kit plus an eval harness. Vanessa will lead the playbook draft and the marketplace listing checklist.

Proposed agenda for a 30m technical sync (suggested owners):
1) 5m intro + goals (Grace)
2) 10m API schema & sample payloads (Jonas)
3) 8m tracing contract & telemetry handoff (Jonas)
4) 7m partner playbook & commercial checklist (Vanessa)

Available slots: Tue 3/16 10:00-11:30 PT, Wed 3/17 14:00-16:00 PT. Do either work? If so, we'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (playbook draft attached).

FWIW, two items to prep on your side: a) a small sample index (1–3 documents) and b) expected throughput (rps) on ingest so Jonas can simulate KV-cache usage.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: 2027-03-16-playbook-draft.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: LLamaIndex + LangChain API Schemas & Partner Playbook Discussion

Thanks Grace — quick internal notes / prep items before we lock the sync:

Technical scope items (I'll lead):
- API contract: confirm field-level constraints (max doc length, allowed metadata types, tokenization expectations). Action: ask Sprocket for one canonical ingestion JSON and a sample document set.
- Model variants & fallbacks: need to know if they require a deterministic favorite model (e.g., redwood-1-small) or if we can route low-cost requests to quantized variants.
- KV cache & TTL: estimate cache size per customer and retention policy; depending on their retrieval hit-rate we may recommend persistent prefix caching.
- Tracing: define the minimal trace payload (trace_id, span_id, start_ts, end_ts, model, route, token_counts). Also determine whether Sprocket will accept protobuf vs JSON POST for telemetry.
- Security: confirm whether PII redaction is required before we persist embeddings or logs.

Commercial / go-to-market (Vanessa): please draft: one-paragraph partner blurb, recommended revenue split, marketplace listing checklist (docs, screenshots, billing contact).

I can prototype a simple curl ingestion and a trace emitter by EOD Tuesday if they confirm sample data.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: LLamaIndex + LangChain API Schemas & Partner Playbook Discussion

1) Tue 3/18 at 10:00 AM PT works for our engineers and PM (I've added a calendar invite).
2) Attached is a 3-document sample payload and a small CSV describing expected rps by environment (dev/staging/prod) — you'll find it in the drive link below as well.
3) For tracing, we prefer JSON over HTTP POST into our telemetry endpoint; we'll share a short spec before the call.
